amlwatcher.text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate issued by Americo Quality Standards Registech, valid to 7 April 2029 with yearly surveillance audits.
Announced in-Kingdom data residency for customers in Saudi Arabia.
Oonagh van den Berg, founder of Raw Compliance, joined as Executive Director, Growth and Advisory.

notabene.text: Announced a strategic investment from Ripple; the amount was not disclosed.
Raised a $14.5 million Series B led by DRW VC.

fourthline.text: Completed its merger with Veridas, with up to EUR 65 million in financing from Finch Capital, Seaya Andromeda and Ashgrove Capital. Paul Stoddart leads the combined company.
Its subsidiary Fourthline Trust Services AB was granted qualified trust service provider status under eIDAS.
Signed an agreement to merge with Veridas.

hawkai.text: Raised a $56 million Series C led by One Peak, at a time when it served more than 80 clients.

napier.text: Marlin Equity Partners announced a majority growth investment in Napier AI.
Companies House lists Lapis Bidco Limited as holding 75% or more of the shares of Napier Technologies Limited from this date.

seon.text: Launched identity verification with document, liveness and proof-of-address checks, starting with Europe.
Raised an $80 million Series C led by Sixth Street.

enigma.text: Raised a $95 million round led by NEA.

unit21.text: Founding engineer Tyler Allen became CEO, and co-founder Trisha Kothari moved to chair of the board.

veridas.text: Completed its merger with Fourthline. Fourthline CEO Paul Stoddart leads the combined company, with Eduardo Azanza as president.
Voice Shield passed iBeta Level 1 presentation attack testing.
Passive Liveness Detection passed iBeta ISO/IEC 30107-3 Level 2 testing.
Announced a EUR 15 million capital increase from its existing partners.
